major_concerns: Emulation fidelity vs production networks may produce misleading safety gains
Potential bias from synthetic topology/intent corpus and chosen vendor set
Validator rule-set selection may under- or over-state baseline capability
Unclear formalization of rollback-aware canary scoring and deployment decision thresholds
Compute/time budget for full emulation sweep may be underestimated
required_design_repairs: Provide formal definition and justification of emulation fidelity and limitations; specify vendor families and rationale
Preregister exact validator rule set and scoring thresholds; publish rules with paper
Include power/sample-size analysis and wall-clock compute estimates
Define rollback-aware canary scoring mathematically and tie to deployment decision rules
Release dataset generation scripts, seeds, prompts, and emulation harness for reproducibility

major_concerns: Label noise from imperfect validators/emulation may bias classifier training
Risk of overfitting classifier to idiosyncrasies of the LLM used to generate training data
Synthetic fault injections may not reflect real-world misconfiguration distributions
Lack of explicit plan to evaluate cross-LLM and cross-vendor generalization
required_design_repairs: Specify classifier architecture, feature set, and training regime (regularization, cross-validation) in preregistration
Add held-out generation from at least one different LLM and vendor-CLI family for generalization testing
Quantify and mitigate label noise (e.g., multiple verifiers, human adjudication on a sample)
Provide compute budget and fallback plan if GPU resources are unavailable; publish dataset and seeds

major_concerns: Construct validity: mapping injected faults to realistic operational misconfigs must be justified
Validator configuration drift and rule tuning could change coverage estimates
Limited vendor set may limit external validity
required_design_repairs: Preregister misconfiguration taxonomy with concrete examples and mapping rules to real-world incidents
Specify exact validator versions/configuration and justify chosen rule thresholds
Allocate emulation-verified sample size for false-negative estimation and report confidence intervals
Explain vendor selection and, if constrained, discuss external validity limits

major_concerns: Realism of adversarial perturbation generators must be demonstrated
Ethical concerns about publishing adversarial generation details (risk of misuse)
Repair loop design may overfit to chosen validator and not generalize
Reproducibility hinges on tight preregistration of adversary strengths and seeds
required_design_repairs: Preregister adversarial perturbation generators, strength levels, and seeds; include rationale and realism validation
Omit exploit-level details in publication; provide high-level descriptions and responsible-disclosure plan
Specify repair algorithm, stopping rules, and thresholds; include sensitivity analyses
Provide compute/time estimates and emulation sampling plan to ensure statistical power
